description: Repairs r-enc-link/update-through-link: the relative link path resolved to the fixture-creation attempt, so the mutations changed one shared source across attempts and the independent reader read an attempt-local copy that stayed unchanged. A host ACCDB is made inside this probe: local table L (copy of SRC) and LK linked to SRC of the input r-enc-link-src with a relative Connect, so the link resolves to this attempt's own inputs. The source is read through an independent Workspace first. Through LK: UPDATE that matches three rows by a duplicated non-key value, INSERT with every field, INSERT without the counter key, DELETE, a 5,000-character memo UPDATE (each dbFailOnError with RecordsAffected; DBEngine.Errors right before and after), then AddNew/Update and Edit/Update on a dynaset (LastModified, ID). LK is read, then the source file through an independent Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
